verdicts.reason: Both are essentially the same broken layout. The 'MERRY' headline has shrunk to a tiny afterthought jammed among the icons at top right. The characters are reduced to a cramped grid of small stickers along the right half, while the left half of the canvas is empty dead space. 'DISCOUNT' is pushed into the bottom-right corner, so the original centered headline lockup is lost and the reading order runs backwards. The only difference is that A's DISCOUNT is a touch larger and sits slightly lower, which isn't a meaningful gap.
